title: Match macro targets and levels
brief: The default macro target comes from module_path!() at the call site; explicit target and macro level change filter selection.

choices.tradeoff: A datafusion_tracing-only directive need not select it.

choices.choose_when: A stable chosen target is useful
choices.tradeoff: Filter that exact target and an enabled level.

claims.statement: Macro arms forward an explicit target or module_path!() to tracing span construction.
INFO/DEBUG and other macro families choose their emission level. A layer can exclude spans at that level.
A matching explicit-target filter captures execution spans; a nonmatching filter captures none. The call-site target contracts is separately observed under its matching filter.

implementation: Inspect the actual invocation and installed filter scope.
Object-store spans use their own source target; test that branch separately.
unknowns: A missing capture alone cannot distinguish filtering from work that did not run.

evidence.scope: Retained exact-release source or documentation; local runtime assertions are linked separately.
